answer.answer: The disagreement recorded for AAPL is not a single figure in CONFLICTING state — the coverage report shows zero CONFLICTING observations. It is an ambiguity record attached to the `debt` metric, flagged MULTIPLE_SOURCE_CONCEPTS with resolution NO_WINNER_SELECTED. The reason is MULTIPLE_SOURCE_CONCEPTS: the same metric label is attached to two different us-gaap source concepts, and the evidence explicitly states these are different measures rather than two readings of one measure, so the evidence does not establish that either is the figure a question about this metric was asking for. The competing values, for the most recent period (instant 2026-06-27, 10-Q accession 0000320193-26-000020), are: us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent = 11,007,000,000 USD and us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent = 71,340,000,000 USD. The same ambiguity recurs at the two preceding periods: at 2026-03-28, 8,310,000,000 vs 74,404,000,000; at 2025-12-27, 11,827,000,000 vs 76,685,000,000. Both observations at each period carry evidence_state SOURCE_REPORTED and validation_status UNVERIFIABLE, with an empty cross-check list — a single official source cannot cross-validate itself. Each concept is mapped PARTIAL to `debt`, with the registry noting each is a component of total debt, never the total on its own; the concepts also map EXACT to separate metrics (long_term_debt_current, long_term_debt_noncurrent), which is what leaves the registry unable to choose. On which value is correct: the evidence settles nothing. ST-EVA has not selected one and does not claim either is a candidate, and same_measure_established is false. I cannot name a winner. Note also that the `debt` series holds 180 points and my read was truncated, so the three periods above are the ambiguity records I actually retrieved, not a complete enumeration of where the pattern occurs; the pattern is visible throughout the retrieved history, where both a current and a noncurrent concept are reported at each date.
uncertainties: The evidence does not establish which value is correct; the recorded resolution is NO_WINNER_SELECTED with same_measure_established false, so the question of the correct figure is left open by design.
The `debt` metric history is truncated: 180 points held, 12 returned. The three dated ambiguity pairs cited are the ones retrieved, not the complete set of periods at which the pattern occurs.

No cross-check exists for either competing value — validation_status is UNVERIFIABLE and get_validation returns an empty list for obsarch_f3fadf4d01e44338521c5246, so agreement between sources has not been tested here.

Whether the metric intended was total debt, or one of its two components, is a registry/filer question the evidence marks NOT_EXPLAINED; the mapping to `debt` is PARTIAL and the concept is flagged AMBIGUOUS_MAPPING against several metrics.

Separately, an unresolved vendor observation (obsarch_7429c7068c9299b29190bfba, YahooFinance, 95,000,000,000 USD for 2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30) sits in the revenue series with no registry mapping and a methodology note that it is a value ST-EVA did not retrieve from a source. It is not part of a recorded ambiguity and its period differs from the nearest filed periods, so I am not treating it as the disagreement you asked about, but it is held and unexplained.
